This is a placeholder post. Replace this content with your own thoughts, tutorials, or project write-ups.

### Getting Started

Edit blog posts by modifying the JSON files in `src/data/blog/`. Each file is one post.

**Fields to update:**
- `title` — your post title
- `excerpt` — short description shown in the listing
- `tag` — a label for the post
- `date` — publication date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- `content` — full post content, supports **Markdown**
- `published` — set to `false` to hide a draft
